Reach

Questions

Before you save your seat

Why is it $17 and not free?

Because people who invest, even a little, show up and actually try what they learn. I want a room full of people ready to date differently.

Is this only for women?

It’s for feminists of any gender who date anyone. First-timers, late bloomers, situationship alumni and people dating again after divorce, loss or a long relationship are all welcome.

I’ve never really dated. Is it for me?

Yes. Nothing here assumes experience. We start with what you want, not with what you’ve done.

What if I can’t make it live?

Save your seat anyway. Every seat includes the full replay.

Will you talk about Main Character Dating at the end?

For the last few minutes I’ll share how to apply for my programme, for anyone who wants to go further. Everything before that is yours to use either way.

Script 1 · “Three dumb rules”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Three dating rules I’d love to retire forever.”

Body

“One: wait three days to text back. Two: never make the first move. Three: lower your standards. I was a matchmaker. I’ve seen what actually works, and it’s the opposite of all three. Dating works when you build it around what you want.”

CTA

“I’m breaking every one of them live in my class, Break the Dumb Dating Rules. Seats are $17. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: talking to camera, warm brick wall behind you (like your profile photo), three on-screen cards with a red line through each rule. No “you’re single” or age language in captions.

Script 2 · “Essence over checklists”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“The question I asked every matchmaking client first.”

Body

“Not ‘how tall?’ or ‘what job?’. It was: how do you want to feel with this person? That’s an Essence-Based Preference, and it changes who you say yes to, and who you stop wasting time on.”

CTA

“I’ll walk through how to find yours, live, for $17, replay included. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: notebook on a table, a long checklist crossed out, then three feeling words written underneath. Reuses your Essence-Based Preferences guide idea.

Script 3 · “No such thing as too late”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“There is no deadline on love. I said what I said.”

Body

“I’ve coached first-time daters, people dating again after divorce and people who swore they’d missed their window. The timeline was never the problem. The rules were.”

CTA

“Join my live class, Break the Dumb Dating Rules. $17. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: direct to camera, quick cuts, your Main Character Dating energy. Keep it about the rules and the timeline, never about the viewer’s age or relationship status.
